text:
The plate is a square side plate, roughly 20-22 cm across. I estimated each item from how much of it I could see.

**Almonds:** I count about 35 whole almonds. At roughly 1.2 g each, that comes to about 42 g. Almonds run about 579 kcal per 100 g.

**Spinach leaves:** There are about 8 to 10 fresh leaves, which I put at around 20 g. Spinach is about 23 kcal per 100 g.

**Shredded carrot:** The few visible shreds weigh about 3 g. Carrot is about 41 kcal per 100 g.
